data.gender_notes: Aabidaah is used as a female name in Arabic and Urdu naming tradition.
data.short_meaning: Female worshipper; devout woman (variant spelling of ʿĀbidah)
data.long_meaning: Aabidaah (عابدة) is an Arabic name meaning “Female worshipper; devout woman”. It is an orthographic variant of Arabic ʿābidah (عابدة), the feminine of ʿābid 'worshipper', from the root ʿ-b-d. The earlier meaning recorded for this file, 'Servant of Allah', was incorrect: that is ʿAbdullāh (عبد الله), a different construction.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabidaah carries the meaning Female worshipper; devout woman. The name expresses devotion; this is its documented lexical sense rather than an added doctrinal claim.
data.etymology: Orthographic variant of Arabic ʿābidah (عابدة), feminine of ʿābid 'worshipper'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabidaah total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aabidaah mean?
faq.a: Aabidaah means Female worshipper; devout woman.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aabidaah?
What language does the name Aabidaah come from?
faq.a: Aabidaah is used in Arabic and Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aabidaah a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabidaah is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aabidaah written in Arabic?
faq.a: Aabidaah is written عابدة in Arabic, عابدہ in Urdu and आबिदा in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aabidaah?
faq.a: The root of Aabidaah is ʿ-b-d (ع-ب-د), from ʿābidah (عابدة).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aabidaah?
faq.a: Aabidaah is an orthographic variant of Arabic ʿābidah (عابدة), the feminine of ʿābid, worshipper.

faq.q: Does Aabidaah appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabidaah is not itself a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Does Aabidaah mean Servant of Allah?
faq.a: No. That meaning was previously recorded for this file in error. Servant of Allah is ʿAbdullāh (عبد الله), a different construction. Aabidaah means female worshipper, from the root ʿ-b-d.

faq.q: Is Aabidaah the same name as Aabida?
faq.a: Yes. Aabida, Aabidah and Aabidaah are all transliterations of the same Arabic name ʿābidah (عابدة).

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabidaah verified?
faq.a: Yes. The meaning Female worshipper rests on the Arabic feminine active participle ʿābidah, from ʿ-b-d.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aabidaah?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabidaah total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is traditionally associated with responsibility, care and harmony. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aabidaah?
faq.a: Variants and alternative transliterations include Abida, Aabida and Abidah.

faq.q: Where is the name Aabidaah used today?
faq.a: Aabidaah circulates chiefly in Arabic and Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
